newsitem.title: GREECE: TOURKOLIAS TAKES OVER SHIPPING AT NATIONAL BANK - SOURCE.
newsitem.headline: TOURKOLIAS TAKES OVER SHIPPING AT NATIONAL BANK - SOURCE.

text.p: Alekos Tourkolias, formerly head of shipping at the Bank of Nova Scotia- Athens, will be the new director of the shipping division at state National Bank of Greece from June 1, a high-level National Bank source told Reuters.

"Tourkolias will take over the shipping division at National Bank from June 1," he said. "The move is part of the bank's strategy to modernise its shipping operations in order to face the challenges of increasing competition in the sector."
Tourkolias was in charge of shipping operations at Bank of America, Athens for 10 years before joining the Bank of Nova Scotia, the source said.
"His mandate is to pursue an aggressive policy of attracting top quality clientele," he added.
The top-level official said there would be no changes in the treasury department of National Bank.
"It is not true that there will be changes in the treasury department as reported in the press," the official said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
